Commentary.Commentary: Sri Lanka will be disappointed. They would have loved to end the game early on. They had the chances but dropped too many catches. It was Maheesh Theekshana who started the job with the ball. He was unable to play and then Dushan Hemantha and Sahan Arachchige handled the middle phase well. Sri Lanka had a chance to get all 10 wickets under 200 but gave chance after chance to West Indies. Now then, this is still a chaseable target. West Indies are missing some key names while Sri Lanka have batted well so far. Let's see how it goes...

Excellent recovery from West Indies. They were 123 for 7 at one stage, losing wickets in heaps and failing to build a stand but then came the heroics from Keacy Carty. He along with some crucial knocks from Romario Shepherd and Kevin Sinclair has given West Indies something to bowl at.

OUT! GONE! This is too short and outside off. Carty tries to ramp it over but plays all over. He slices it high to long off where the catch is taken cleanly. Fine knock from Carty! West Indies are bowled out for 243.

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set but before that, it is time for the national anthems. It will be the Windies first followed by of the Lankans. All done now. Time for action. Johnson Charles and Brandon King to open the batting. Dilshan Madushanka to bowl.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Dimuth Karunaratne, Kusal Mendis (WK), Sadeera Samarawickrama, Charith Asalanka, Sahan Arachchige, Dasun Shanaka (C), Dushan Hemantha, Maheesh Theekshana, Matheesha Pathirana, Dilshan Madushanka.
West Indies (Playing XI) - Brandon King, Johnson Charles, Keacy Carty, Shai Hope (C/WK), Nicholas Pooran, Shamarh Brooks, Kyle Mayers, Roston Chase, Kevin Sinclair, Romario Shepherd, Akeal Hosein.
Shai Hope says it is important to start well and get a big total on the board. Informs Brooks is back in the team. Shares they will try and be clinical just like the previous match.

Dasun Shanaka says they will bowl as they want to make the most of the conditions. Adds they don't want to take this game lightly and give hundred percent against a quality side. Reckons it is important to take wickets early on. Informs Wanindu Hasaranga and Dhananjaya de Silva are not playing due to slight niggles.
TOSS - Sri Lanka have won the toss and will BOWL first!

Hello and welcome to the final game of the Super Sixes where Sri Lanka will take on the Windies. On any other occasion, this match-up would have been massive knowing how strong these two international teams have been. It is still a big one for the Asian team who are looking to continue their winning streak but not so for the Windies. Times have changed for them, they came into this tournament as one of the favourites but destiny has put them right down in the black hole. In the last game, we saw West Indies play much better without much pressure on them. Sri Lanka have sealed the top spot as well but will look to ride the momentum. Who do you think will win? Stay tuned for the chase.
